status: premium visual direction approved; final production model, handle and trademark clearance still pending

character.name: Nuvibù
character.role: joyful cloud guide and recurring hero
character.silhouette: compact plush cloud body with five rounded lobes, one curled tuft, tiny rounded hands and short lavender feet
immutable_features: single curled tuft centered on top
large glossy blue-violet eyes with two clear catchlights
joyful open smile with a small pink tongue and no visible teeth
small rainbow-and-stars emblem on the lower right side of the body
approved_actions: peek from behind a cloud or prop
point to a color, animal or object
land in a clear celebratory pose
forbidden: clothing or hats unless explicitly approved for a special episode

rendering_rules.style: premium polished 3D preschool animation with plush materials, soft cinematic lighting and strong mobile readability
rendering_rules.detail: rich and specific, never empty; one clear focal action with organized supporting details
rendering_rules.color: vivid, saturated and joyful while preserving clean separation between characters and background
rendering_rules.consistency: every scene must use the approved character reference or a locked model/LoRA/3D rig

camera_rules.cuts: clean rhythmic cuts, motivated transitions and occasional smooth push-ins
camera_rules.movement: lively but readable; no random camera shake, strobe or aggressive whip-pan
camera_rules.subject_occupancy: main character or action should occupy 40–75% of the frame
camera_rules.first_hook: a face, reveal or transformation must be visible within the first 2 seconds

audio_rules.vocal_style: warm, clear, energetic and natural; no robotic delivery or exaggerated baby talk
audio_rules.chorus_rule: the central hook must be understandable and repeatable after one listen
